title: Filtered colimit of smooth algebras ('PT holds')
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $\Lambda$ a commutative $R$-algebra. *$\Lambda$ is a filtered colimit of smooth $R$-algebras* (in Stacks, Smoothing Ring Maps: *PT holds for $R\to\Lambda$*) if there are a small filtered category $J$ (filtered in the sense of Stacks, Categories, Definition Tag 002V: $J$ has at least one object, any two objects of $J$ map to a common object, and any two parallel arrows $a,b:x\to y$ are equalized by some arrow $c:y\to z$, $c\circ a=c\circ b$), a functor $j\mapsto B_j$ from $J$ to the category of commutative $R$-algebras (the transition maps $B_j\to B_{j'}$ being homomorphisms of $R$-algebras) such that every $B_j$ is a smooth $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], and homomorphisms of $R$-algebras $\iota_j:B_j\to\Lambda$ such that $(\Lambda,(\iota_j)_{j\in J})$ is a colimit of the diagram $j\mapsto B_j$ in the category of commutative $R$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

split_report.summary: Checked against Stacks smoothing.tex Section 07F1 / Situation 07F2 (tags verified in tags/tags: 07F1 smoothing-section-reduction, 07F2 smoothing-situation-global) and categories.tex Definition 002V (categories-definition-directed: 'directed, or filtered', which requires at least one object) and Definition 002F (categories-definition-colimit). The definition is well formed: data = a small filtered J, a functor J -> commutative R-algebras with smooth values, and a colimit cocone with vertex Lambda in R-algebras; it is an existential condition, so it needs no choice and is trivially independent of the diagram, and isomorphic data give the same notion. It contains no claim: that the colimit is also one of rings and of sets (lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-algebras-elementwise), the factorization criterion (lem-weil-pbc-factorization-criterion-filtered-colimit, Stacks 07C3) and PT for products (Stacks Lemma lemma-product right after the definition) are statements about the notion used by its users, not by the definition, so no new node was created. Stacks states PT only in Situation 07F2 (R -> Lambda regular, Noetherian); the node defines it for any R -> Lambda, which is the same condition with the hypothesis dropped and is what Popescu's theorem and Algebra 07C3 use. Statement change: 'filtered' is now spelled out with Stacks 002V including nonemptiness, because def-weil-pbc-category-colimit defines filtered without 'at least one object' (for PT itself this changes nothing: the empty diagram has colimit R, which is smooth over R, so a one-object diagram also works; but lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-algebras-elementwise (2) is false for the empty category, see the report). Mathlib: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.ind applied to the property Algebra.Smooth R on CommAlgCat R is this definition word for word (Mathlib's IsFiltered includes Nonempty, ColimitPresentation is a colimit cocone in CommAlgCat R); verified with sed on the Mathlib source; status set to mathlib with that match. No Lean candidate in the source repository.
